title: Round-trip legacy measurement projects without losing unknown data
scope: Schema-1 original archives/recipes for the slice, bounded decompression, unknown plugin/member preservation and failure-safe session load.
acceptance: Original archives reopen equivalent pose/units/IDs/recipes/results; unknown plugin content survives disabled-plugin round trips.
Missing/corrupt/oversized archive and cancellation leave the current session intact; no invented replacement format.
open_items: M3d native scan/marked-plane save/read implemented from main 54dbd5f in PR113, source 3fe64e69956faad4e1c3d901a305f49ff17bee5f. One corpus passes 22/22 original/Rust controls (12 successful loads, 10 refusals); actual nextId=-99 red run rejects all 22, then clean rerun passes. Comparison output: evidence/2026-11-05-m3d-project-comparison.json.gz. Original project hook runs under SSR with original archive functions over an adapted worker transport; no reference geometry is fed to Rust. Authored DEFLATE input is read by both implementations; the original reader also accepts Rust-written archives.

M3 supported slice: standalone STL/PLY/OBJ, marked-plane recipes and saved fits, pose/units/source bytes/IDs, old per-element settings defaults, unknown root plugin parts and their unowned members. Engine owns IO/state/history; CLI supplies --save/files and writes atomically. Native cancellation test forces a deadline then releases late preparation, preserving source/graph/elements/history.

Broader M6 remains open: reference/image/companion reconstruction, measured maps, other fitted/constructed/seeded families, dimensions/sections, 2D work, workspaces beyond Measure, finishing rebuilds without a saved fit and ZIP64 are explicit pre-commit Unavailable paths. Writer uses interoperable ZIP stored members, so files may be larger than the original deflated writer.

Source size/name/schema checks are retained. Additional native bounds: 128 MiB archive/aggregate decompression, existing 64 MiB source/mesh/store budgets, two million JSON nodes and 128 parser levels; original schema nesting remains 64. Host resource refusals are distinct from source errors.

Verification label and roster registration remain the owner-scheduled M3 batch under the 2026-11-05 budget. Existing acceptance text, ci_report.py and native roster are unchanged; no acceptance or fixed-corpus promotion is claimed.
